conditioning: ARM-I: rendered emission image (3 ch) + coord (2)

preprocessing.C: whole frame, no crop: 2026 the raw RGGB Bayer frame packed to 4 planes; 2024/2023 the stored demosaiced frame re-mosaiced onto the RGGB grid (R top-left, G top-right and bottom-left, B bottom-right of each 2x2 cell; 2024 recordings are stored BGR, 2023 reports RGB); planes /255, area-resized to out_size
preprocessing.E: the rendered emission image as displayed, RGB in [0,1], area-resized to out_size (2026 tile PNG 1920x1080; 2024 HDF5 emissions 1920x1080 RGB; 2023 npy 1024x1024 float 0..255 stored BGR through OpenCV, reversed to RGB and clipped)

protocol.noise_rule: one generator per session, manual_seed(EVAL_SEED), one draw per row in row order
protocol.primary: pooled AUROC of correct residual vs per-row mean of the available wrong-offset residuals; paired fraction P(correct < wrong-mean)
protocol.secondary: single wrong row, offset OFFSETS[row mod 5] mirrored at the session ends (the zkdiff proof-row rule)
protocol.claim_boundary: emission-recording correspondence under a change of rig, camera, alignment and emission family; no realness, liveness or capture claim

d2.note: published eval blocks (60-row guards), in-distribution sanity check

row_bootstrap.rule: row bootstrap, rows resampled with replacement, seed EVAL_SEED

secondary_single_wrong_mod5_mirrored.rule: row bootstrap, rows resampled with replacement, seed EVAL_SEED

2026.note: august (same session as training) excluded from the 2026 pool
